# RQAI

Radical Questions. Applied Intelligence.
Independent software for research, writing and creative work, with specialist tools for orthopaedics.
Founder and current operator: Inayat Panda, trading as RQAI.
RQAI Technologies Ltd is a proposed company name; the company has not yet been incorporated.
Contact: hello@rqai.co.uk

## Apps and projects

- [researchassistant](https://rqai.co.uk/researchassistant/): Plan, run and write up research. Run systematic reviews, statistics and health-economic analyses. Write the manuscript and prepare submission files in the same app.
- [clinicalproms](https://rqai.co.uk/projects/clinicalproms/): Collect patient scores and track recovery. Send patients questionnaires and track their scores over time. See changes against published thresholds for meaningful improvement.
- [chapbook](https://rqai.co.uk/chapbook/): Write and publish a blog from your phone. Write posts in a chat-style editor. Add photos, video and interactive elements, then publish to your own website.
- [audioquill](https://rqai.co.uk/projects/audioquill/): Turn speech into written documents. Transcribe recordings, edit the text and combine notes into documents. Export as Word, PDF or Markdown.
- [scribble](https://rqai.co.uk/scribble/): Keep notes with text, images and sketches. Write notes, add pictures and sketches, and publish selected pages to your website. AI tools are optional.
- [podium](https://rqai.co.uk/projects/podium/): Rehearse presentations and interviews. Import your slides, choose a practice room and rehearse with a simulated audience. Record a take and review it.
- [literature-decoded](https://rqai.co.uk/projects/literature-decoded/): Read open-access orthopaedic research. Browse orthopaedic studies by subject. Read reformatted articles and follow the links to the original publications.
- [thestreetsignal](https://rqai.co.uk/projects/thestreetsignal/): Read market analysis and track its results. Read the morning market report, explore charts and check how previous calls performed, including the misses.

## Orthopaedic tools and research

- [Orthopaedics](https://rqai.co.uk/orthopaedics/): OrthoLog, OrthoConsultantPrep, OrthoPortfolio and Universal Shoulder Model, grouped for training, career development and research.
- [ortholog](https://rqai.co.uk/ortholog/): Record operations and what you learn. Log operations, add learning notes and review your experience. Use the app on your phone or computer.
- [orthoportfolio](https://rqai.co.uk/orthoportfolio/): Organise your Portfolio Pathway application. Import PDFs up to 100 MB, review evidence gaps, edit your own reflections and export indexed PDFs with page-level splitting. Multiple PDF parts download together in a ZIP. Patient-identifiable information must be removed before import; optional AI sends submitted content to the selected provider.
- [consultantprep](https://rqai.co.uk/consultantprep/): Practise for a T&O consultant interview. Revise interview questions, review Trust information and practise timed answers. Keep notes on the topics you need to revisit.
- [universal-shoulder-model](https://rqai.co.uk/universal-shoulder-model/): Study shoulder anatomy and movement. Explore anatomy, compare saved scenarios and examine prescribed movement. This research software is still in development.
